title: Geology
author: Wikipedia contributors
attribution: Wikipedia contributors, “Geology”, English Wikipedia. Text available under CC BY-SA 4.0; see source history for contributors.
paragraphs: Geology is a branch of natural science concerned with the Earth and other astronomical bodies, the rocks of which they are composed, and the processes by which they change over time. The name comes from Ancient Greek γῆ (gê) 'earth' and λoγία (-logía) 'study of, discourse'. Modern geology significantly overlaps all other Earth sciences, including hydrology. It is integrated with Earth system science and planetary science.

Geology describes the structure of the Earth on and beneath its surface and the processes that have shaped that structure. Geologists study the mineralogical composition of rocks in order to get insight into their history of formation. Geology determines the relative ages of rocks found at a given location; geochemistry (a branch of geology) determines their absolute ages. By combining various petrological, crystallographic, and paleontological tools, geologists are able to chronicle the geological history of the Earth as a whole. One aspect is to demonstrate the age of the Earth. Geology provides evidence for plate tectonics, the evolutionary history of life, and the Earth's past climates.

Geologists broadly study the properties and processes of Earth and other terrestrial planets. Geologists use a wide variety of methods to understand the Earth's structure and evolution, including fieldwork, rock description, geophysical techniques, chemical analysis, physical experiments, and numerical modelling. In practical terms, geology is important for mineral and hydrocarbon exploration and exploitation, evaluating water resources, understanding natural hazards, remediating environmental problems, and providing insights into past climate change. Geology is a major academic discipline, and it is central to geological engineering and plays an important role in geotechnical engineering.

sentence.text: By combining various petrological, crystallographic, and paleontological tools, geologists are able to chronicle the geological history of the Earth as a whole.
sentence.translation: 通过结合岩石学、晶体学和古生物学的多种研究工具，地质学家能够梳理整个地球的地质历史。
sentence.analysis: 主干是 geologists are able to chronicle the geological history。By combining… 是“by＋动名词”结构，作方式状语，表示实现主句行为的方法；combining 的逻辑主语是 geologists。petrological、crystallographic 和 paleontological 是并列形容词，共同修饰 tools。be able to 后接动词原形，表示具备做某事的能力；as a whole 表示“作为一个整体”。

questions.prompt: 根据第一段和第三段，哪项最准确地概括了地质学的研究范围？
options: 研究地球及其他天体的岩石、结构和变化过程
只研究可供开采的矿物和能源资源
只研究现代气候，排除过去的变化
只研究地球表面的岩石，不涉及地下结构
questions.explanation: 第一段把 Earth and other astronomical bodies、岩石及其随时间变化的过程纳入研究范围；第三段也提到 Earth and other terrestrial planets。因此不能把地质学局限于地表、资源开采或现代气候。
hints: 找能覆盖所问范围的概括，排除只描述局部的选项。
回到第 1、3 段，逐项核对主体、范围及表示条件或程度的词。

questions.prompt: 根据第二段，地质学家研究岩石的矿物组成，直接目的是什么？
options: 证明所有岩石的形成时间相同
用矿物名称取代地质年代划分
排除化学分析在地质研究中的作用
questions.explanation: 第二段写道，地质学家研究 mineralogical composition，“in order to get insight into their history of formation”。in order to 明确引出目的，即了解岩石的形成历史。
hints: 区分原因与结果，不要把相关现象直接当作因果。
回到第 2 段，逐项核对主体、范围及表示条件或程度的词。
